title: World, Difficulty & Dimensions
h1: Minecraft World Guide: Difficulty, Nether, End, Seasons and World Resets
description: Minecraft survival world guide covering Easy difficulty, terrain, when the Nether and End open, Nether portal alignment, season resets and the world border.
intro: A survival server's world rules decide how the game feels: difficulty, what generates, when new dimensions open and when the world resets. These answers cover those rules in plain language. Gilly SMP is the worked example.

items.q: What difficulty does a Minecraft survival server run on?
items.a: Gilly SMP runs on Easy, the mode the survival rework is balanced around. Some mobs such as creepers, skeletons and cave spiders are toned down, and the difficulty never rises on its own.

items.q: What does the terrain look like on this Minecraft survival server?
items.a: Gilly SMP uses vanilla terrain and biomes, with extra ores, trees and structures such as abbeys and beta villages. Everything uses vanilla blocks, so no mods are needed.

items.q: Are there villages in this Minecraft survival world?
items.a: The survival rework expects you to build your own village on Gilly SMP. Advancements explain how to bring villagers to it.

items.q: Is there a world border on this Minecraft server?
items.a: No world border is set on Gilly SMP yet. If one is added, its size will be listed on the wiki.

items.q: Can I go to the Nether on a Minecraft survival server?
items.a: Not yet. On Gilly SMP both the Nether and the End are closed for now and will open in stages. The Nether opens after the next major update.

items.q: How do I line up Nether portals on a Minecraft server?
items.a: Once the Nether opens on Gilly SMP, /portal tells you where to build a portal in the other dimension so the two line up. Nether portals can be any size or shape.

items.q: Does the Minecraft world reset on a survival server?
items.a: Yes. On Gilly SMP the world resets at the end of every season. You can ask for a copy of the world on Discord one week after the season ends.

items.q: Is there a random teleport command on a Minecraft server?
items.a: There is no /rtp command on Gilly SMP. Instead, an RTP cannon at spawn fires you 500 to 5000 blocks away onto safe ground, with a slow fall and a 30-second cooldown.
